title: Establish team and project baseline
acceptanceCriteria: Required documents exist
Deployment isolation and shared source explicit
Unresolved decisions and prioritized tickets recorded
Independent PM and QA review recorded
Existing work preserved and no secrets
description: Owner: Developer subagent. Documentation only; no app features. PM review and QA validation required. User merge approval required.

title: Django/PostgreSQL foundation (recommended first implementation)
dependencies: SETUP-001 merged (Done); D-001 adopted. Current scope is local development/testing; production hosting is deferred.
acceptanceCriteria: Django project and dependency lock exist
development and automated-test configuration uses PostgreSQL
configuration comes from environment
startup fails clearly for missing required settings
example environment contains placeholders only
health endpoint exposes no secrets
clean-install and test commands are documented and actually run
no storefront feature is included.
description:
Owner: Developer role. Issue #2 claimed before work. - Priority: P0. Dependencies: SETUP-001 merged (Done); D-001 adopted. Current scope is local development/testing; production hosting is deferred.
- Acceptance: Django project and dependency lock exist; development and automated-test configuration uses PostgreSQL; configuration comes from environment; startup fails clearly for missing required settings; example environment contains placeholders only; health endpoint exposes no secrets; clean-install and test commands are documented and actually run; no storefront feature is included.

title: Isolated local retailer configuration
acceptanceCriteria: one code revision configures two independent local retailer instances on one development machine
instances use distinct ports/local hosts, PostgreSQL databases/users, secrets and filesystem media roots
test media roots are separate and media is gitignored
storage backend remains configurable for later cloud selection
smoke checks demonstrate data and image isolation
eventual independent production servers/domains/storage remain required but deferred
no cloud setup or production deployment is included.
description: Removed by user on 2026-10-10. Historical ticket retained for traceability; no implementation planned.

title: Retailer staff authentication and access control
dependencies: MVP-001; D-004 admin-only scope agreed; Django admin selected by PM.
acceptanceCriteria: single admin/superuser can log in/out through Django admin
anonymous, inactive and non-admin users cannot access admin operations
tests cover direct URL access and permission failures
no staff role matrix, custom admin UI or public registration is included.
description:

empty catalog renders safely.

User authorized implementation 2026-10-10; Developer owns combined feature/mvp-003-004-admin-categories. Code implemented; PostgreSQL validation and remote publication blocked. See docs/tickets/MVP-003-004.md.

title: Products, variants and images

products belong to database categories
active/inactive visibility is enforced
validated image uploads use configured storage
invalid uploads fail safely
variant identifiers are unique within the retailer
product and variant edit permissions are tested.

- Acceptance: staff manage products and agreed variant attributes/SKUs; products belong to database categories; active/inactive visibility is enforced; validated image uploads use configured storage; invalid uploads fail safely; variant identifiers are unique within the retailer; product and variant edit permissions are tested.

price and stock changes have agreed audit evidence.

title: Responsive browse, search and product detail
acceptanceCriteria: mobile and desktop layouts expose database categories, products, variants, current prices and availability
search/filter behavior is agreed and tested
empty/error states are usable
keyboard navigation and image descriptions work
browser evidence records viewport, browser and commit. Zilly is inspiration only
do not copy licensed assets.
description:
- Priority: P0. Dependencies: MVP-004-006; D-009 visual direction approved.

tampered totals cannot affect order values.
description:

- Acceptance: customers add/update/remove agreed variants; quantities are validated; totals are calculated server-side using current authoritative prices; stale price and stock changes are explained; cart persistence follows agreed guest/account rules; tampered totals cannot affect order values.

configured branding appears responsively
invalid images/links are rejected
inactive banners are hidden
missing configuration has safe defaults.
description:
- Priority: P1. Dependencies: MVP-003, MVP-007; D-009.
- Acceptance: staff configure retailer name, logo, agreed colors/contact fields and ordered active banners; configured branding appears responsively; invalid images/links are rejected; inactive banners are hidden; missing configuration has safe defaults.

acceptanceCriteria: staff configure agreed zones, charges, minimums and availability
